scope: Local source, packaged artifact and browser verification. No package release, tag or hosted deployment. Later evidence-only commits do not change the tested product/build inputs.

commands.source: uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra ocr; ruff check src tests studies/mixed-conventions; ruff format --check src tests studies/mixed-conventions; mypy src; pytest -q
commands.web: npm ci; npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm run format:check; npm test; npm run build; npm run build:demo; playwright test
commands.build: uv run --locked --extra dev --extra ocr python scripts/bundle_ui.py; uv build
commands.minimumDirectResolution: List the wheel plus all project runtime and dev/ocr optional requirements in requirements.in; uv pip compile --python 3.11 --resolution lowest-direct requirements.in; uv pip sync into a fresh venv.
commands.installedBrowser: FIELDPROOF_BROWSER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:59494/ playwright test --config ../studies/mixed-conventions/browser.config.mjs (runner and tests from the same clean archive; installed server started outside checkout with PYTHONPATH and FIELDPROOF_STATIC_DIR unset)
commands.receiptReplay: uv run --locked --extra dev --with pyarrow python -I studies/cord-grounding/run.py --src <source/src> --out <rows.jsonl> --workers 4 --stated

publicReceiptReplay.scope: Annotation replay using unchanged driver and stated dataset defaults. No fresh OCR/model run; unchanged wrong locations remain.

harnessNotes: Applying lowest-direct only to the wheel resolved current dependencies; that Python 3.11 run is reported as current dependencies. Minimum direct requirements were then resolved explicitly and tested separately.
The first installed-browser invocation mixed runners/tests from two checkouts and was rejected by Playwright before tests ran. The corrected invocation uses one checkout and passes both engines.
Minimum ReportLab regenerated metadata-different PDFs. All installed comparisons were rerun with --reuse-pdfs and now use byte-identical inputs.
Minimum-dependency tests pass with two dependency deprecation warnings.

The server does not expose caller fallback options; UI status counts were already 2 verified / 2 review without defaults. False verification before/after is demonstrated through the library and CLI, while the UI now explains the conflict.
